name: Zenovia Arthur
original_name: ゼノヴィア＝アルスール
source:
Though still young, this saint has outstanding abilities that have earned her the position of court priest.

With God's blessing, she can perform miracles such as purifying evil spirits and healing.
Her powers are so great that she is said to be able to heal any injured person as long as they are not dead.

She is a kind-hearted woman who shows mercy to even the most evil of people.

She is sometimes called a hypocrite who only speaks nice things, but that is not her true nature; she can be stubborn and inflexible when it comes to sticking to her belief that she wants to help people.
